facts.fact: BujaHub says it ran a 3-month incubation programme under the UNDP-backed Moonshot initiative with a cohort of 70 selected entrepreneurs.
BujaHub says it has offices in Bujumbura and Gitega (80 and 30 coworking places) and ran its incubation with entrepreneurs from Bujumbura, Gitega and Ngozi, including provincial sessions.
